description: Shared library of inspection parameters, referenced by id from templates, spec rules and brand profiles. `aliases` are the words other sources (and the AI) use for the same check — the validator merges them instead of listing duplicates. `when` makes a parameter conditional on an extracted attribute. `qualified: true` marks checks that must be done by a qualified technician; their instructions never ask for disassembly or bypassing a safeguard. `required` defaults to weight >= 3 and `requiresEvidenceOnFail` to the categories in priorities.json unless set here.

physical_condition.title: Overall Physical Condition
physical_condition.description: Inspect the whole item for damage beyond normal wear.
instructions: Inspect every face of the item under good light
Note cracks, dents, bends, breaks or missing parts
Photograph any damage found with a scale reference
physical_condition.expectedResult: No structural or functional damage; wear consistent with the declared condition.

cosmetic_condition.title: Cosmetic Condition
cosmetic_condition.description: Grade surface wear against the provider's declared condition.
instructions: Look for scratches, scuffs, discolouration and stains
Compare the wear against the declared condition grade
Photograph representative wear
cosmetic_condition.expectedResult: Cosmetic wear matches the declared condition.

declared_condition.title: Declared Condition Grade
declared_condition.description: Compare the item's overall state with the condition the provider declared.
instructions: Read the declared condition grade
Decide whether the observed state matches, exceeds or falls short of it
Record the grade you would assign
declared_condition.expectedResult: Observed condition matches the declared grade.

cleanliness.title: Cleanliness & Hygiene
cleanliness.description: Check the item is clean and fit to hand to a customer.
instructions: Check for dirt, residue, odour and pests
Check food-contact or skin-contact surfaces closely
cleanliness.expectedResult: Clean, odour-free and ready for use.

serial_number.title: Serial Number
serial_number.description: Record the serial number and confirm it is consistent everywhere it appears.
instructions: Read the serial number from the physical label
Where the device shows one in its settings or firmware, confirm it matches the label
Photograph the label
serial_number.expectedResult: Serial number is present, legible and consistent.

model_identification.title: Make & Model Identification
model_identification.description: Confirm the item is the make and model listed.
instructions: Read the model number from the label, nameplate or system information
Compare it with the listed brand and model
model_identification.expectedResult: Make and model match the listing.

accessories_declared.title: Declared Accessories
accessories_declared.description: Confirm every accessory the provider listed is present and working.
instructions: Tick off each declared accessory
Check each accessory for damage
Test powered accessories with the item
accessories_declared.expectedResult: All declared accessories present and serviceable.

power_on.title: Power-On Test
power_on.description: Confirm the item powers on normally from its own supply.
instructions: Connect the item's own charger or power cable
Power on and observe the start-up
Note any error lights, beeps, smells or abnormal noise and power off immediately if present
power_on.expectedResult: Powers on normally with no error indications.

power_supply_safety.title: Power Cable & Adapter Condition
power_supply_safety.description: Check the mains cable, plug and adapter are safe to use.
instructions: Inspect the cable, plug and adapter without opening them
Look for exposed conductors, cuts, scorch marks, bent pins or a loose plug
Do not use the item on a damaged cable — record it and stop
power_supply_safety.expectedResult: Cable, plug and adapter intact with no exposed wiring or heat damage.

ports_io.title: Ports & Connectors
ports_io.description: Check every port and connector is intact and working.
instructions: Inspect each port for bent pins, debris or looseness
Test each port with a known-good cable or device
ports_io.expectedResult: All ports physically intact and functional.

display_condition.title: Display Condition
display_condition.description: Inspect the physical and visual condition of the display.
instructions: Check the glass for cracks, chips and deep scratches
Show full-screen white, black, red, green and blue to find dead or stuck pixels
Look for backlight bleed, burn-in, lines and discolouration
display_condition.expectedResult: No cracks, dead pixels, lines or burn-in; uniform colour.

display_brightness.title: Display Brightness & Controls
display_brightness.description: Confirm brightness adjusts across its full range.
instructions: Adjust brightness from minimum to maximum
Confirm the screen stays stable without flicker
display_brightness.expectedResult: Brightness adjusts smoothly with no flicker.

touchscreen.title: Touchscreen Response
touchscreen.description: Confirm touch input works across the whole screen.
instructions: Draw lines across the full screen in a drawing or test app
Check multi-touch with a pinch gesture
Note dead zones or phantom touches
touchscreen.expectedResult: Touch registers everywhere with no dead zones or phantom input.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.description: Test every key and the keyboard's physical state.
instructions: Type every key in a keyboard test page or text editor
Check for sticky, missing or unresponsive keys
Check the keyboard backlight if fitted
keyboard.expectedResult: Every key registers once per press; no missing or damaged keys.

touchpad.title: Touchpad
touchpad.description: Test cursor movement, clicks and gestures.
instructions: Move the cursor across the whole surface
Test left and right click and two-finger scroll
Check the surface for cracks
touchpad.expectedResult: Smooth tracking; clicks and gestures register.

hinge_condition.title: Hinge Condition
hinge_condition.description: Check the lid hinge holds the screen and moves smoothly.
instructions: Open and close the lid through its full range
Check the screen stays at any angle without drooping
Listen for cracking and look for gaps at the hinge
hinge_condition.expectedResult: Hinge firm and smooth; screen holds position.

boot_os.title: Boot & Operating System
boot_os.description: Confirm the device boots to a working operating system.
instructions: Boot the device from power off
Confirm it reaches the desktop or home screen without errors
Confirm the operating system is activated and not locked to a previous user
boot_os.expectedResult: Boots cleanly to a working, unlocked operating system.

storage_health.title: Storage Health
storage_health.description: Read the drive's health status from software.
instructions: Open the built-in disk utility or a SMART reader
Record the health status and any reported errors
storage_health.expectedResult: Drive reports healthy with no errors.

battery_health.title: Battery Health
battery_health.description: Read the battery's health or capacity from the device.
instructions: Go to the device's battery health screen or system report
Record the maximum capacity and, where shown, the cycle count
Compare with any figure the provider declared
battery_health.expectedResult: Battery health reported and consistent with the declaration.

battery_safety.title: Battery Swelling & Heat
battery_safety.description: Look for signs of a swollen or overheating battery without opening the device.
instructions: Place the device on a flat surface and check it sits flat with no rocking
Check for a lifted screen or panel, a bulging back or separating seams
Feel for abnormal heat during charging
If any sign of swelling is found, stop, do not charge or press on it, and flag for a qualified technician
battery_safety.expectedResult: No swelling, bulging or abnormal heat.

charging.title: Charging
charging.description: Confirm the device charges from its own charger.
instructions: Connect the declared charger
Confirm the charging indicator appears
Confirm the charge level rises over several minutes
charging.expectedResult: Charges normally from the supplied charger.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Confirm the device connects to a Wi-Fi network.
instructions: Connect to a known Wi-Fi network
Load a web page

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.description: Confirm Bluetooth pairs with another device.
instructions: Pair with a test phone or headset
Confirm the connection stays up

webcam.title: Webcam
webcam.description: Confirm the built-in camera gives a clear image.
instructions: Open the camera app
Check the image is clear and the indicator light works

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Confirm the built-in microphone records clearly.
instructions: Record a short voice clip
Play it back and check for clarity and noise
microphone.expectedResult: Clear recording without crackle or dropouts.

speakers_output.title: Speakers & Audio Output
speakers_output.description: Confirm built-in speakers and the audio output work.
instructions: Play audio across the volume range
Check left and right channels
Listen for distortion, rattle or crackle
speakers_output.expectedResult: Clear audio on all channels at all volumes.

account_lock.title: Account & Activation Lock Removed
account_lock.description: Confirm the device is not locked to the previous owner's account or a firmware password.
instructions: Check the device is signed out of the previous owner's account
Check activation or anti-theft locks are off
Check no firmware or BIOS password is set
account_lock.expectedResult: No account, activation or firmware lock remains.

back_body.title: Back Panel & Frame
back_body.description: Inspect the back glass or panel and the frame.
instructions: Check the back glass or panel for cracks
Check the frame for dents and bends
Check the camera lens covers for cracks
back_body.expectedResult: No cracks or bends; lens covers intact.

rear_camera.title: Rear Camera
rear_camera.description: Test every rear lens, focus and flash.
instructions: Take a photo with each rear lens
Check autofocus and image sharpness
Test the flash or torch
Record a short video
rear_camera.expectedResult: Every lens focuses and produces a clear image; flash works.

front_camera.title: Front Camera
instructions: Take a selfie photo and video
Check focus and clarity

face_unlock.title: Face Recognition (Face ID)
face_unlock.description: Confirm face recognition can be set up and unlocks the device.
instructions: Enrol a test face in the face-recognition settings
Lock and unlock the device with it
Remove the test enrolment afterwards

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint Sensor
fingerprint.description: Confirm the fingerprint sensor enrols and unlocks.
instructions: Enrol a test fingerprint
Unlock with it several times
Remove the test enrolment afterwards

cellular.title: Cellular Network & SIM
cellular.description: Confirm the device registers on a mobile network and makes calls.
instructions: Insert a test SIM or activate a test eSIM
Confirm network registration and signal
Make and receive a short call; test mobile data
cellular.expectedResult: Registers on the network; calls and data work.

imei.title: IMEI
imei.description: Record the IMEI and confirm it matches the device and is not blocklisted.
instructions: Dial *#06# to display the IMEI
Confirm it matches the IMEI in settings and on the SIM tray or box where printed
Check the IMEI against the national blocklist service
imei.expectedResult: IMEI consistent everywhere and not blocklisted.

physical_buttons.title: Physical Buttons & Switches
physical_buttons.description: Test every hardware button and switch.
instructions: Press each button and toggle each switch
Check each gives a positive click and the expected action

liquid_damage.title: Liquid Damage Indicator
liquid_damage.description: Check visible liquid-contact indicators without opening the device.
instructions: Where the manufacturer places an indicator in the SIM slot or a port, inspect it with a torch
Look for corrosion in the ports

genuine_parts.title: Parts & Service History
genuine_parts.description: Check the device's own record of replaced or non-genuine parts.
instructions: Open the device's parts or service history screen where the manufacturer provides one
Record any part reported as replaced, unknown or non-genuine
genuine_parts.expectedResult: No unknown or non-genuine parts, or replacements disclosed by the provider.

stylus.title: Stylus / Pen
stylus.description: Confirm the stylus pairs, charges and draws accurately.
instructions: Pair or attach the stylus
Draw across the screen and check pressure response
Check the tip is not worn

lens_optics.title: Lens & Optics
instructions: Shine a torch through the lens from the rear
Look for scratches, fungus, haze, dust and separation
Check the front and rear lens caps
lens_optics.expectedResult: No fungus, haze, separation or significant scratches.

sensor_condition.title: Sensor Condition
sensor_condition.description: Check the image sensor for dust, marks and dead pixels using test shots only.
instructions: Shoot a plain bright surface at a narrow aperture
Inspect the image for spots, marks and hot or dead pixels
Do not touch or clean the sensor
sensor_condition.expectedResult: No marks or pixel defects visible in test shots.

shutter_autofocus.title: Shutter & Autofocus
shutter_autofocus.description: Test shutter release across speeds and autofocus.
instructions: Fire the shutter at several speeds
Check autofocus locks in single and continuous modes
Record a short video with sound
shutter_autofocus.expectedResult: Shutter fires at all speeds; autofocus locks reliably.

shutter_count.title: Shutter Count
shutter_count.description: Read the shutter actuation count from the camera.
instructions: Read the count from the camera menu or an image's metadata
Compare with any figure declared
shutter_count.expectedResult: Shutter count read and consistent with the declaration.

lens_mount.title: Lens Mount & Contacts
lens_mount.description: Inspect the mount and electronic contacts.
instructions: Check the mount for wear or looseness
Check contacts are clean and undamaged
Mount a lens and confirm it communicates
lens_mount.expectedResult: Mount firm; lens communicates with the body.

memory_card_slot.title: Memory Card Slot
memory_card_slot.description: Confirm the card slot reads and writes.
instructions: Insert a test card
Format it in the device, then save and review a file
memory_card_slot.expectedResult: Card reads and writes without error.

projection_quality.title: Projected Image Quality
projection_quality.description: Check the projected image for brightness, focus and defects.
instructions: Project a test pattern onto a plain surface
Check focus across the image, colour uniformity and keystone correction
Look for spots, dead pixels or colour banding
projection_quality.expectedResult: Sharp, uniform image without spots or banding.

light_source_hours.title: Lamp / Light Source Hours
light_source_hours.description: Read the lamp or light-source usage hours from the menu.
instructions: Open the information or service menu
Record lamp or light-source hours and compare with the rated life
light_source_hours.expectedResult: Hours recorded; remaining life reasonable for the hire.

cooling_fan.title: Cooling & Ventilation
cooling_fan.description: Confirm cooling works and vents are clear, from the outside only.
instructions: Run the item for 15 minutes
Check the vents are unobstructed and airflow is present
Listen for grinding fans and check for overheating warnings
Do not open the casing or touch moving fans
cooling_fan.expectedResult: Airflow present, no overheating warnings or abnormal fan noise.

remote_control.title: Remote Control
remote_control.description: Confirm the remote controls the item.
instructions: Test power, input selection and navigation from the remote

video_inputs.title: Video Inputs
video_inputs.description: Test each video input with a live source.
instructions: Connect a source to each HDMI or video input
Confirm picture and sound on each
video_inputs.expectedResult: Every input shows picture and sound.

mounting_hardware.title: Stand, Mount & Rigging Points
mounting_hardware.description: Check stands, brackets and mounting points are complete and sound.
instructions: Check every stand, bracket and mounting point for cracks or bends
Confirm all fixings are present
Flag any load-bearing damage for a qualified rigger

audio_output_test.title: Audio Output Test
audio_output_test.description: Play a reference signal through the system across its range.
instructions: Play music and a sweep at low, medium and moderate volume
Check every driver is producing sound
Listen for distortion, buzz, crackle or rattle
audio_output_test.expectedResult: Clean output from every driver across the range.

speaker_drivers_grille.title: Drivers, Cones & Grilles
speaker_drivers_grille.description: Inspect visible drivers and grilles from the outside.
instructions: Inspect grilles for dents and visible cones for tears or pushed-in dust caps
Do not remove grilles or press on cones
speaker_drivers_grille.expectedResult: No torn cones or damaged grilles.

audio_connectors.title: Audio Inputs & Connectors
audio_connectors.description: Test XLR, jack and speaker connectors.
instructions: Connect a source to each input
Wiggle-test connectors for crackle or dropouts
audio_connectors.expectedResult: All inputs pass signal without crackle.

mixer_controls.title: Mixer Faders, Knobs & Channels
mixer_controls.description: Test every channel, fader and knob on the mixer.
instructions: Route a source through each channel
Move each fader and knob through its range and listen for scratching
Check meters respond
mixer_controls.expectedResult: Every channel passes audio; controls move without noise.

wireless_mic.title: Microphones
wireless_mic.description: Test each microphone and its receiver.
instructions: Pair each wireless mic with its receiver
Speak at distance and check for dropouts and interference
Check battery compartments for corrosion
wireless_mic.expectedResult: Every mic clear with no dropouts.

cables_included.title: Cables & Leads
cables_included.description: Check supplied cables for damage and correct count.
instructions: Count cables against the declaration
Inspect for cuts, crushed sections and damaged plugs

vehicle_documents.title: Registration, Insurance & Permits
vehicle_documents.description: Check the vehicle's legal documents are valid for the hire period.
instructions: Check the registration certificate
Check insurance validity dates
Check pollution certificate and any commercial permit or fitness certificate required for hire use
vehicle_documents.expectedResult: All documents present, in the vehicle's name as listed, and valid through the hire period.

vin_chassis.title: Chassis & Engine Number
vin_chassis.description: Match the stamped chassis/VIN and engine numbers with the registration.
instructions: Locate the chassis/VIN plate and engine number
Compare both with the registration certificate
Photograph both
vin_chassis.expectedResult: Chassis/VIN and engine numbers match the registration.

registration_plate.title: Registration Plate
registration_plate.description: Confirm the number plate matches the documents and is legible.
instructions: Compare front and rear plates with the registration certificate
Check both are fixed and legible
registration_plate.expectedResult: Plates match the documents and are legible.

odometer.title: Odometer Reading
instructions: Read the odometer with the ignition on
Photograph the reading
odometer.expectedResult: Reading recorded and consistent with any declared figure.

exterior_body.title: Exterior Bodywork
instructions: Walk around the vehicle and inspect every panel
Note dents, scratches, rust and paint mismatch
Photograph all four sides and every damage point
exterior_body.expectedResult: Bodywork condition recorded; no damage beyond the declared condition.

glass_mirrors.title: Windscreen, Windows & Mirrors
glass_mirrors.description: Check glass and mirrors give a clear, safe view.
instructions: Check the windscreen for cracks in the driver's view
Check every window operates
Check mirrors are intact and adjustable
glass_mirrors.expectedResult: No cracks in the driver's view; windows and mirrors work.

tyres.title: Tyres & Spare Wheel
tyres.description: Check tread, sidewalls and pressures, including the spare.
instructions: Measure tread depth on each tyre with a gauge
Inspect sidewalls for cuts and bulges
Check pressures with a gauge
Check the spare wheel, jack and wheel spanner are present
tyres.expectedResult: Tread at or above the legal minimum on every tyre; no sidewall damage; spare present.

brakes.title: Brakes
brakes.description: Check brake feel and the parking brake with the vehicle stationary; any road test is by a qualified driver only.
instructions: With the engine running and the vehicle stationary, press the brake pedal: it should be firm, not sink
Check the parking brake holds the vehicle on level ground
Check for brake warning lights
Any moving brake test must be done by a qualified, licensed driver at walking pace in a closed, safe area
brakes.expectedResult: Firm pedal, parking brake holds, no brake warnings.

lights_signals.title: Lights & Indicators
lights_signals.description: Test all exterior and interior lights.
instructions: Test headlights on low and high beam, tail lights, brake lights, indicators and hazard lights
Test reverse lights and number-plate lights

horn_wipers.title: Horn & Wipers
horn_wipers.description: Test the horn, wipers and washers.
instructions: Sound the horn
Run the wipers at every speed and the washers

engine_start.title: Engine Start & Idle
engine_start.description: Start the engine and observe the idle with the vehicle parked.
instructions: With the vehicle parked in neutral or park, start the engine
Observe a steady idle and listen for knocking or misfire
Look for excessive smoke from the exhaust
Do not rev the engine hard
engine_start.expectedResult: Starts promptly, steady idle, no abnormal noise or smoke.

dashboard_warnings.title: Dashboard Warning Lights
dashboard_warnings.description: Check no warning lamps remain lit after start-up.
instructions: Turn the ignition on and confirm the warning lamps light briefly
Start the engine and confirm they go out
Record any lamp that stays on
dashboard_warnings.expectedResult: No warning lamps lit with the engine running.

fluid_levels.title: Fluid Levels & Leaks
fluid_levels.description: Check fluid levels and look for leaks with the engine off and cool.
instructions: With the engine off and cool, check engine oil on the dipstick and coolant in the expansion tank
Check brake and washer fluid reservoirs
Look under the vehicle for fresh drips
Never open a hot coolant cap
fluid_levels.expectedResult: Levels within marks; no active leaks.

vehicle_battery.title: 12V Battery
vehicle_battery.description: Check the starter battery from the outside.
instructions: Check the battery is secured
Look for corrosion on terminals and a cracked case
Do not touch both terminals or disconnect anything
vehicle_battery.expectedResult: Secured, no corrosion or damage; vehicle starts.

seats_seatbelts.title: Seats & Seatbelts
seats_seatbelts.description: Count the seats and test every seatbelt.
instructions: Count usable seats and compare with the declared seating capacity
Pull and latch every seatbelt; check each retracts and locks on a sharp pull
Check seat adjusters and headrests
seats_seatbelts.expectedResult: Seat count matches the claim; every belt latches and locks.

transmission_automatic.title: Automatic Transmission
transmission_automatic.description: Check gear selection with the vehicle stationary and the brake held.
instructions: With the engine running and the brake firmly held, move the selector through P, R, N and D
Confirm each position engages smoothly without clunks or delay
Confirm no transmission warning appears
Any driving check is by a qualified driver at low speed in a safe area
transmission_automatic.expectedResult: Each gear engages promptly and smoothly; no warnings.

transmission_manual.title: Manual Gearbox & Clutch
transmission_manual.description: Check clutch feel and gear selection while stationary.
instructions: With the engine off, check the clutch pedal travel and return
With the engine running and the clutch pressed, select each gear while stationary and check for grinding
Any driving check is by a qualified driver at low speed in a safe area
transmission_manual.expectedResult: Clutch smooth; every gear selects without grinding.

air_conditioning.title: Air Conditioning
air_conditioning.description: Confirm the air conditioning cools in every zone.
instructions: Run the AC on maximum cooling with the engine running
Check cold air from every vent, including rear vents where fitted
Check the blower works at every speed
air_conditioning.expectedResult: Cold air from all vents at every blower speed.

interior_condition.title: Interior Condition
instructions: Check seats for tears and stains
Check the dashboard, door trims and floor mats
Note odours
interior_condition.expectedResult: Interior clean and consistent with the declared condition.

fuel_level.title: Fuel Level
fuel_level.description: Record the fuel level at handover.
instructions: Read the fuel gauge with the ignition on
Photograph the gauge

safety_kit.title: Safety Kit
safety_kit.description: Check the safety equipment carried in the vehicle.
instructions: Check the warning triangle, first-aid kit and, where carried, a fire extinguisher within its service date
safety_kit.expectedResult: Safety kit present and in date.

refrigeration_unit.title: Refrigeration Unit
refrigeration_unit.description: Confirm the refrigeration unit reaches and holds temperature.
instructions: Run the unit and record the temperature display
Check the cargo box reaches the set temperature within the stated time
Check door seals
refrigeration_unit.expectedResult: Reaches and holds the set temperature.

unit_count.title: Unit Count
unit_count.description: Count every unit in the lot.
instructions: Count every unit individually
Compare with the listed quantity
Record any shortfall
unit_count.expectedResult: Counted quantity equals the listed quantity.

structural_integrity.title: Structural Integrity
structural_integrity.description: Check load-bearing parts are sound and the item is stable in use.
instructions: Check legs, frames and joints for cracks, looseness or repairs
Place on a level floor and check for wobble
Apply moderate hand pressure as a user would; do not stand on or overload the item
structural_integrity.expectedResult: No cracks or loose joints; stable under normal load.

wood_joints.title: Wood Joints, Grain & Splits
wood_joints.description: Check wooden parts for splits, loose rungs and failed glue joints.
instructions: Check every joint and rung for movement
Look along the grain for splits and cracks
Check for woodworm holes
wood_joints.expectedResult: Joints tight; no splits or woodworm.

surface_finish.title: Surface & Finish
surface_finish.description: Check paint, polish, lacquer or plating.
instructions: Check for chips, scratches, peeling or flaking finish
Check the finish is consistent across the lot

upholstery.title: Upholstery & Cushions
instructions: Check for tears, stains, fading and loose stitching
Check cushions are firm and attached
upholstery.expectedResult: No tears or stains; cushions intact.

folding_mechanism.title: Folding / Stacking Mechanism
folding_mechanism.description: Check folding or stacking works and locks.
instructions: Fold and unfold, or stack and unstack, several units
Check locks engage and there are no pinch hazards from bent parts
folding_mechanism.expectedResult: Folds or stacks smoothly; locks engage.

material_verification.title: Material
material_verification.description: Confirm the item is made of the material declared.
instructions: Inspect exposed surfaces, underside and edges
Compare with the declared material

gas_safety.title: Gas Connection Safety
gas_safety.description: Check gas hoses, regulators and valves; leak testing by a qualified technician only.
instructions: Inspect hoses for cracks, hardening and expiry dates
Check regulators and valves operate and shut fully
Leak testing is done by a qualified gas technician using an approved leak-detection solution — never a flame
gas_safety.expectedResult: Hoses in date and undamaged; valves shut fully; no leaks found by the qualified test.

electrical_safety_appliance.title: Electrical Safety
electrical_safety_appliance.description: Check the appliance's electrical safety from the outside; testing is by a qualified electrician.
instructions: Inspect the cord, plug and casing for damage without opening
Confirm an earth connection is present on the plug where required
Portable-appliance or insulation testing is carried out by a qualified electrician only
electrical_safety_appliance.expectedResult: No visible electrical damage; qualified test passed where performed.

heating_function.title: Heating Performance
heating_function.description: Confirm the appliance reaches and holds its set temperature.
instructions: Set a known temperature
Measure with a probe thermometer once it indicates ready
Check the thermostat cycles
heating_function.expectedResult: Reaches the set temperature within tolerance.

cooling_function.title: Cooling Performance
cooling_function.description: Confirm the unit reaches and holds its set temperature.
instructions: Run the unit empty
Measure the internal temperature with a probe thermometer after the stated pull-down time
Check door seals for gaps
cooling_function.expectedResult: Reaches the set temperature; seals close fully.

food_contact_hygiene.title: Food-Contact Surfaces
food_contact_hygiene.description: Check food-contact surfaces are clean, rust-free and intact.
instructions: Check trays, racks and interiors for rust, pitting and residue
Check non-stick coatings are not flaking

door_seals.title: Doors, Hinges & Seals
door_seals.description: Check doors close and seal properly.
instructions: Open and close every door
Check hinges and gaskets for damage
Check latches hold
door_seals.expectedResult: Doors close and seal; latches hold.

components_complete.title: Components & Fixings Complete
components_complete.description: Count every component and fixing needed to assemble the item.
instructions: Lay out all sections, pins, clamps, bolts and connectors
Count against the declared parts list
Check threads and pins are undamaged

load_rating_docs.title: Load Rating & Certification
load_rating_docs.description: Check load ratings and any certification for structures that carry people or rigged loads.
instructions: Check the manufacturer's load rating label or documentation
Check any inspection certificate and its date
Structural assessment is by a qualified rigger or engineer
load_rating_docs.expectedResult: Load rating known and documentation current.

fabric_canopy.title: Fabric & Canopy
instructions: Unfold and inspect for tears, holes, mould and failed seams
Check zips, eyelets and straps
fabric_canopy.expectedResult: No tears, mould or failed seams.

lighting_function.title: Lighting Fixtures
lighting_function.description: Test every fixture and its control.
instructions: Power each fixture
Test colours, dimming and movement, and DMX control where fitted
Check lenses and clamps
lighting_function.expectedResult: Every fixture lights and responds to control.

generator_output.title: Electrical Output
generator_output.description: Measure output voltage and frequency at the outlet; qualified electrician only.
instructions: With the generator running and no load, a qualified electrician measures voltage and frequency at the output terminals
Repeat under a known test load
Compare with the rated output
generator_output.expectedResult: Voltage and frequency within rated tolerance.

run_hours.title: Running Hours
instructions: Read the hour meter
Compare with the service record
run_hours.expectedResult: Hours recorded; service interval not overdue.

guards_emergency_stop.title: Guards & Emergency Stop
guards_emergency_stop.description: Confirm safety guards are fitted and the emergency stop works.
instructions: Check every guard and cover is fitted and undamaged
Test the emergency stop shuts the machine down
Never run the machine with a guard removed
guards_emergency_stop.expectedResult: All guards fitted; emergency stop works.

service_records.title: Service Records
instructions: Review the service log
Confirm the last service date and that no service is overdue

function_general.title: Primary Function Test
function_general.description: Confirm the item performs the function it is listed for.
